Privacy policy

Last updated: October 14, 2026

Meuble Confort & Style sells furniture online and delivers it to Montréal, Laval and Longueuil. This policy explains what personal information we collect, why, who we share it with, and how to exercise your rights under Québec’s Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector.

Person in charge of personal information

Zacharie Bien-Aimé, owner
Email: meubleconfortstyle@gmail.com
Phone: 438-879-8019
Mailing address: 7566 rue Saint-Hubert, Montréal, QC H2R 2N6

What we collect

  • When you order: your name, email, phone, billing and delivery addresses, and what you ordered. Payment is handled by Stripe: we never see or store your card number.
  • When you write or call us (phone, Messenger, Instagram): your name, your contact details and what you tell us.
  • When you browse the site: our host keeps technical logs (IP address, browser type, pages requested). Your cart and your cookie choice are kept in your own browser, not by us.
  • Only if you accept cookies: the Meta pixel records pages viewed, products viewed, add-to-cart, checkout start and purchases.

Why

  • To process and charge your order, call you to book delivery, deliver it, and provide after-sales service and warranty.
  • To answer your questions.
  • To meet our legal obligations, including tax law.
  • Only with your consent: to measure how our Facebook and Instagram ads perform.

We do not sell your personal information.

Cookies and advertising

The Meta pixel is off by default: it only loads if you click “Accept” in the cookie banner. If you accept and then order, our server also reports the purchase to Meta with your email, phone, name and address in hashed form (SHA-256, unreadable to Meta and to us), along with the IP address and browser used for the order. If you decline, none of this is sent.

You can change your mind at any time with the “Cookies” link at the bottom of every page. If you withdraw consent, the pixel stops loading and the Meta cookies set on our site are deleted.

Who we share it with

Only with companies that provide a service to us, and only what they need:

  • Stripe — order payments.
  • HighLevel (LeadConnector) — our customer management software, which holds your contact details, orders and messages.
  • Meta Platforms — messages you send us through Messenger or Instagram, and ad measurement if you accepted it.
  • Vercel — website hosting.
  • Google Fonts and Shopify — fonts and product photos load from their servers, which therefore receive your IP address.

Our delivery team receives your name, address and phone number to deliver your order.

These providers are largely located outside Québec, notably in the United States, so your information may be stored and processed there. We only share what the service requires.

How long we keep it

Only as long as needed for the purposes above or as required by law. For an order, that includes the warranty period and the retention period required by tax law, which is six years. The information is then destroyed or anonymized.

Your rights

You can:

  • find out what information we hold about you and get a copy, including in a structured, commonly used technological format;
  • have it corrected if it is inaccurate, incomplete or ambiguous;
  • withdraw your consent;
  • ask us to stop disseminating it or using it for advertising.

Write to Zacharie Bien-Aimé at meubleconfortstyle@gmail.com. We reply within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Commission d’accès à l’information du Québec.

Security

The site is served over an encrypted connection (HTTPS), and access to your information is limited to the people who need it to serve you. If a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious harm, we notify the people concerned and the Commission d’accès à l’information.

Minors

The site is not directed at people under 14, and we do not knowingly collect their information.

Changes

Any change to this policy will be published on this page, with its date.
